# Everbreeze SitePix

> Capture, organize, and share construction job site photos with AI-powered analysis. Built for contractors and field teams.

Everbreeze SitePix lets construction crews snap, tag, and share photos straight from the field. Behind-the-scenes AI drafts site logs from your photos, transcribes walkthrough audio into structured reports, and enriches captions — all delivered as client-ready PDFs.
